title: Metallic ducts.
officialText:
All metallic ducts shall be constructed as specified in the SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards —
Metal and Flexible.
Exception: Ducts installed within single dwelling units shall have a minimum thickness as specified in Table 603.4.
